chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever acquires a garment, let him keep it clean.'

key_terms.اتَّخَذَ: Takes/acquires — implies taking ownership or making habitual use of something
key_terms.ثَوْب: Garment, cloth — any item of clothing worn on the body
key_terms.لْيُنَظِّفْهُ: Let him clean/purify it — an imperative of obligation or strong recommendation

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about keeping clothes clean?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a prophetic instruction on personal cleanliness and care of clothing. The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches that owning a garment entails a responsibility to maintain its cleanliness. In the early Islamic context, this instruction addressed both hygiene and the dignity of one's appearance before God and fellow believers, reflecting the broader Islamic principle that physical purity is a branch of faith.
word_analysis: then let him keep it clean
